---
title: Baked Cheese Custard
id: MAR-0073
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 35
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 230 g grated Parmigiano Reggiano
- 180 g ricotta
- 70 g mascarpone
- 1 whole egg + 1 egg yolk
## Method
1. 20 g butter, nutmeg, black pepper. Sift the ricotta and pour it into a bowl.
2. Add the Parmigiano Reggiano, mascarpone, egg, egg yolk, a pinch of nutmeg, and a generous grinding of black pepper.
3. Mix well to combine the ingredients.
4. Butter 4 individual molds with the butter, pour in the cheese mixture, and level the surface with a spatula.
5. Bake in a water bath in the oven at 180 °C for about 15-20 minutes.
